headline: Prepare the information your family will need when you cannot provide it.
description: Continuity Binder guides you through the people, accounts, documents, obligations, property, wishes, and instructions a surviving spouse, partner, executor, or trusted family member may need after a death.
trust: Your binder is created in your browser. What you enter is encrypted on this device and is not sent to us.
cta: Fill Your Post-Death Family Continuity Binder
freeNote: Free as in beer. No account. No subscription. No catch.
quietNote: You can print the finished binder, save it as a PDF, export human-readable files, or create an encrypted backup.
localBody: Binder data stays in this browser unless you explicitly export it.
encryptedBody: Saved binder records are encrypted before they are written to local browser storage.
noTrackingBody: No analytics, advertising pixels, session replay, or third-party trackers.
stepOneBody: People, addresses, phone numbers, accounts, and contacts become reusable records.
stepTwoBody: Complete each section at your own pace. Your progress is saved locally.
stepThreeBody: Print it, save a PDF, export readable files, or create an encrypted backup.
clarificationBody: The application itself is downloaded from this website. The information you enter into your binder is not transmitted by the application. As with any browser-based software, a compromised device, browser, extension, or unlocked session can expose information. Keep your device secure and store exported or printed copies carefully.
